{α : Type} → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α → List UInt8 → Option α
∀ {α : Type} (framed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α) {bytes : List UInt8} {value : α}, framed.decode bytes = Option.some value → framed.encode value = bytes
∀ {α : Type} (framed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α) (value : α), framed.decode (framed.encode value) = Option.some value

∀ {α : Type} (framed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Framed α) {other : List UInt8}, other ≠ framed.frame → ∀ (tail : List UInt8), framed.decode (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode other ++ tail) = Option.none

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 3 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.badMac → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.foreignKey → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.malformed → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError) → t.ctorIdx = 2 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.rootMismatch → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch) → t.ctorIdx = 2 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.foreign → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → ((epoch : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.labelled epoch)) → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → ((version : UInt8) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.unlabelled version)) → motive t

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (accumulator : String), accumulator ≠ host.accumulator → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := accumulator, commands := host.commands }.differing host = [ToString.toString "history accumulator: Store " ++ ToString.toString accumulator ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.accumulator]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (commands : String), commands ≠ host.commands → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator, commands := commands }.differing host = [ToString.toString "command codecs: Store " ++ ToString.toString commands ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.commands]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (logTag : String), logTag ≠ host.logTag → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator, commands := host.commands }.differing host = [ToString.toString "log tags: Store " ++ ToString.toString logTag ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.logTag]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (schemaRefs : String), schemaRefs ≠ host.schemaRefs → { stateKey := host.stateKey, schemaRefs := schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator, commands := host.commands }.differing host = [ToString.toString "cell schema references: Store " ++ ToString.toString schemaRefs ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.schemaRefs]

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (stateKey : String), stateKey ≠ host.stateKey → { stateKey := stateKey, schemaRefs := host.schemaRefs, logTag := host.logTag, accumulator := host.accumulator, commands := host.commands }.differing host = [ToString.toString "state-key codec: Store " ++ ToString.toString stateKey ++ ToString.toString ", this Host " ++ ToString.toString host.stateKey]

∀ (start : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (left right : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainAfter start (left ++ right) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainAfter (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainAfter start left) right

∀ {previous : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {bytes : List UInt8} {record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord}, Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.recordFrame.decode bytes = Option.some record → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainStepStored previous bytes = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.chainStep previous record

{α : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body → Type} → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey → (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) → List UInt8 → (derive : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body) → (rootOf : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) → (∀ (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body), rootOf body (derive body) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes body) → Except Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError ((body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) × α body)

∀ {α : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body → Type} (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (bytes : List UInt8) (derive : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body) (rootOf : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (exact : ∀ (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body), rootOf body (derive body) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes body), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealedWith key rootBytes bytes derive rootOf exact = (fun body => ⟨body, derive body⟩) <$> Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes bytes

∀ {α : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body → Type} (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (bytes : List UInt8) (derive : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body) (rootOf : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (exact : ∀ (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body), rootOf body (derive body) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes body), Except.map Sigma.fst (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealedWith key rootBytes bytes derive rootOf exact) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes bytes

∀ {α : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body → Type} {key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey} {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {bytes : List UInt8} {derive : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body} {rootOf : (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body) → α body → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {exact : ∀ (body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body), rootOf body (derive body) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes body} {body : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Body} {derived : α body}, Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealedWith key rootBytes bytes derive rootOf exact = Except.ok ⟨body, derived⟩ → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes bytes = Except.ok body ∧ rootOf body derived = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes body

∀ (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (sealed : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.Sealed), sealed.mac ≠ Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointMac key sealed.body sealed.root → ∃ reason, Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointFrame.encode sealed) = Except.error reason ∧ reason ≠ Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.malformed

∀ (key other : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (height : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (frontier : List (ℕ × Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (indexRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State), other.id ≠ key.id → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointFrame.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealCheckpoint other rootBytes height chain frontier indexRoot state)) = Except.error Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.OpenError.foreignKey

∀ (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (height : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (frontier : List (ℕ × Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (indexRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.openSealed key rootBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.checkpointFrame.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealCheckpoint key rootBytes height chain frontier indexRoot state)) = Except.ok { keyId := key.id, height := height, chain := chain, frontier := frontier, indexRoot := indexRoot, state := state }

∀ (key : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.MacKey) (rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (height : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (frontier : List (ℕ × Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (indexRoot : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) (state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State) {root : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest}, root = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.worldRoot rootBytes { keyId := key.id, height := height, chain := chain, frontier := frontier, indexRoot := indexRoot, state := state } → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealAt key height chain frontier indexRoot state root = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.sealCheckpoint key rootBytes height chain frontier indexRoot state

∀ (rest : List UInt8), (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelledFrame Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelCommandsV1) ++ rest)).refusal = Option.some "this Store was born in another epoch (command codecs: Store commands/v1, this Host commands/v2); re-genesis the world"

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (seed : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Seed), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.refusalFor host (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytesFor host ((Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.seedFrameFor host).encode seed)) = Option.none

∀ (rest : List UInt8), (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelledFrame Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelWithoutAccumulator) ++ rest)).refusal = Option.some "this Store was born in another epoch (history accumulator: Store none, this Host history/mmr-v1;index/trie-v1;checkpoint/v4); re-genesis the world"

∀ (rest : List UInt8), (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelledFrame Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelWithoutCommands) ++ rest)).refusal = Option.some "this Store was born in another epoch (command codecs: Store none, this Host commands/v2); re-genesis the world"

∀ (epoch : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (rest : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytesFor epoch (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.seedFrameFor epoch).frame ++ rest) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.labelled epoch

∀ (label : String) (rest : List UInt8), Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelledFrame label) ++ rest) = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelledFrame label))

∀ (rest : List UInt8), (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelledFrame Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.labelSpentMap) ++ rest)).refusal = Option.some (ToString.toString "this Store was born in another epoch (cell schema references: Store schema-refs/v5, this Host " ++ ToString.toString Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.persistedSchemaRefs ++ ToString.toString "; log tags: Store DREGG/NATIVE-HOST/LOG-TAG/v3, this Host DREGG/NATIVE-HOST/LOG-TAG/v4; history accumulator: Store history/mmr-v1;spent/trie-v1;checkpoint/v3, this Host history/mmr-v1;index/trie-v1;checkpoint/v4); re-genesis the world")

∀ (rest : List UInt8), ∃ named, (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytes (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.seedFrameName ++ [1]) ++ rest)).refusal = Option.some named

∀ (host : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.StoreEpoch) (rest : List UInt8), ∃ named, Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.refusalFor host (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.SeedEpoch.ofBytesFor host (Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.bytesStream.encode (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.seedFrameName ++ [1]) ++ rest)) = Option.some named

∀ {bytes : List UInt8} {record : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord}, Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.recordFrame.decode bytes = Option.some record → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.storedRecordDigest bytes = Minidregg.Compiler.DurableCheckpointCodec.recordDigest record
